body.message:
Your booking has already been confirmed in our system, and we will share the booking confirmation with you shortly.

Please note that our Guest Relations Team will contact you approximately 3 days prior to your check-in date to complete the check-in formalities and provide you with all the necessary information.

On the day of your arrival, our Guest Relations Team will share the apartment details and access instructions with you.

Thank you, and we look forward to welcoming you.
